changes: Independently defined or proved: The active gate occurrences, retaining repeated uses of the same operation.
Independently defined or proved: The actual star/sample link family, with its gate occurrence and kind tags.
Independently defined or proved: Gates whose local branch label is visible at party `p`.
Independently defined or proved: A sample position for each unordered pair of distinct gate participants.
Independently defined or proved: Sample positions incident to a party, without selecting any gate branch.
Independently defined or proved: The star link from an active gate's root to one other participant.
Independently defined or proved: The tagged sample link of one pair position.
Independently defined or proved: The first endpoint, orienting unordered sample pairs by a quotient representative.
Independently defined or proved: The second endpoint of a star or sample link.
Independently defined or proved: The oriented endpoints are exactly the already constructed party set.
Independently defined or proved: Local link incidences read each actual link once.
Independently defined or proved: A star carries one complete gate label, a sample link one index in `Fin k`.
Independently defined or proved: Either endpoint of a star is a participant of its owner gate.
Independently defined or proved: The participating root's local occurrence of its gate label.
Independently defined or proved: A star read at either endpoint as a local virtual incidence.
Independently defined or proved: A sample position read through its actual local sample link.
Independently defined or proved: The local gate-label assignment, including the full ket/bra pair in density applications.
Independently defined or proved: A local virtual assignment with no private-memory or garbage indices.
Independently defined or proved: Gate-label equality at every incident star edge. No sample or physical condition is imposed.
Independently defined or proved: The independent sample indices visible at one party.
Independently defined or proved: Scalar gate coefficients inserted only at their participating root. A singleton gate has no star but its label is still summed at this root.

Independently defined or proved: The actual local operator tensor: sum the party's gate labels, enforce star equalities, insert root-owned coefficients, and evaluate the supplied locally contracted matrix. Any per-slot averaging factor belongs in `c` once, rather than at both endpoints.
Independently defined or proved: Finite virtual alphabets are determined solely by branch labels and sample indices.
Independently defined or proved: One global branch label per active gate occurrence.
Independently defined or proved: One global virtual label per actual star/sample link.
Independently defined or proved: Restrict global gate labels to the occurrences involving party `p`.
Independently defined or proved: Restrict global link labels to those incident to a party.
Independently defined or proved: Restrict a global sample assignment to the sample positions at a party.
Independently defined or proved: Replicate each gate's common label on its star and each sample on its tagged pair link.
Independently defined or proved: A replicated gate assignment satisfies every local star equality.
Independently defined or proved: Consistent virtual assignments and all party-local gate labels.
Independently defined or proved: The common gate assignment recovered at the participating roots.
Independently defined or proved: Recover one sample value from each actual pair link.
Independently defined or proved: A star forces each participant's gate label to equal the participating root's label.
Independently defined or proved: The recovered global labels reconstruct every actual virtual label.

Independently defined or proved: Consistent local labels are exactly global gate labels and independent sample choices. This bijection also covers empty labels, empty link families and singleton gates.
Independently defined or proved: Select the endpoint label at a party from an independent-endpoint configuration.
Independently defined or proved: Reading diagonal endpoint labels is restriction of the same global virtual assignment.
Independently defined or proved: Shared global link labels expose exactly the party's incident sample assignment.
Independently defined or proved: Every gate coefficient occurs once in the product of the local root-owned factors.

Independently defined or proved: The local operator tensor read on the two endpoint incidences of the existing network. All sums over private coordinates have already been supplied in the local matrices.
Independently defined or proved: The actual rectangular operator contracted from the constructed star/sample tensors.
Independently defined or proved: Identity bonds reduce the constructed operator to one label per actual star/sample link.

Independently defined or proved: Exact star/sample operator evaluation: one common gate branch and one sample index per position. The equality is derived from the constructed tensors, not assumed as circuit data. It includes singleton gates, empty alphabets, empty links and `k = 0`.
Independently defined or proved: Matrix form of exact evaluation, using the existing dependent rectangular product matrix.
Independently defined or proved: Exact alphabet dimensions: the gate's branch count on a star and `k` on a sample link. Private-memory and source-support dimensions do not occur in this formula.

Independently defined or proved: A supplied bound on the actual branch alphabets bounds every constructed virtual link. Uniform polynomial branch bounds for a circuit family remain an external obligation.
Independently defined or proved: The common density-branch scalar, with bra conjugation and one gate-owned weight. The weight may contain that gate's per-slot averaging factors, each included once.

Independently defined or proved: The density specialization shares the entire ordered ket/bra pair on each star. The actual network represents the literal branch/sample product-matrix sum, with bra coefficients conjugated and each gate's scalar weight appearing once at its root.
